# peakhour_rp_waf_options (Resource)

Manages reverse proxy WAF options for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_waf_options" "example" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  waf_mode    = "enabled"
  waf_ruleset = "owaspv33"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `waf_mode` (String) WAF mode (spec enum: disabled, enabled, warn). Set to null to clear.
- `waf_ruleset` (String) WAF rule set name (spec enum: atomic, owaspv33, owasp_virtual_patches, virtual_patches, peakhour). Set to null to clear.
- `waf_set_exposed_password_header` (Boolean) Whether to set an exposed password header. Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `excluded_files_json` (String) Computed JSON array of excluded rule groups (disabled files).
- `excluded_rules_json` (String) Computed JSON array of excluded rules (disabled rules).
- `id` (String) WAF options identifier (domain/rp_waf_options).
- `waf_owasp_version` (String) OWASP ruleset version (computed; configured via OWASP settings).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_waf_options.example example.com
```
